messages:
maria (security): quick check — we need the control evidence bundle for the SOC2 fieldwork cutover next week. specifically: KMS rotation logs + staging HSM smoke report. who owns assembling the artifact?
ashok (eng-infra): I can grab the KMS rotation logs. PR to add structured rotation events was merged yesterday (refs: #412). i'll run the extraction job and drop to s3-staging. :thumbsup:
jess (platform): planning note — staging HSM smoke is on my queue but i'm blocked by the pkcs11 driver mismatch that surfaced in today's run. error snippet:```
2026-03-17T14:03:21Z hsmd: handshake failed: pkcs11: module ABI mismatch (expected 2.0, got 1.8)
```
carlos (devex): tagging in — i can do the quick driver pin in the smoke infra and re-run. if we do that, we should also add a one-line howto to the evidence bundle so auditors can reproduce.
maria (security): ownership ask: ash, will the extracted rotation logs include key identifiers + rotation reason + operator id? auditor wants immutable proofs.
ashok (eng-infra): yes — extraction adds key_id, rotation_type, rotated_by, and a signed checksum. i'll also include the commit hash for the rotation playbook.
jess (platform): re: HSM smoke — i can toggle driver to 2.0 in staging for the test. will run at 18:00 PST and post logs. ping @carlos if you want to patch infra now.
carlos (devex): i'll prepare the patch. quick snippet to pin the container:```yaml
containers:
  - name: hsm-test
    image: company/hsm-smoke:stable
    env:
      - name: PKCS11_DRIVER_VERSION
        value: "2.0"
```
maria (security): audit-bot — could you add a reminder to attach the signed checksums to the control evidence ticket once ash uploads?
audit-bot: reminder scheduled -> attach evidence to ticket SEC-2026-22 by 2026-03-20. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
ashok (eng-infra): uploaded rotation logs to s3://redwood-staging/soc2/control-evidence/kms-rotation/5598765432.tar.gz — checksum: sha256:9f3b...6a2. left a short README in the tar.
jess (platform): smoke finished — HSM handshake passed after driver pin. logs: s3://redwood-staging/soc2/control-evidence/hsm-smoke/5598765432.log. no secrets in logs.
maria (security): perfect. next steps: 1) carlos add howto to bundle; 2) ash confirm checksum + upload proof to SEC ticket; 3) i'll do quick verify and flag ready for fieldwork. milestone: aim to close evidence pack by 2026-03-19 EOD. anyone blocked? :eyes:
carlos (devex): on it, will open a small PR to docs and attach to the tar. ETA 2h.
ashok (eng-infra): no blockers from infra side.
jess (platform): none. i'll stand by if auditors ask for another replay.
maria (security): awesome — moving to done for this thread. thanks team!
